notes.title: Demon of the Dark - Paid to FREE
notes.content:
Why?
Taking account of feedback, I have decided to make Demon of the Dark free, as many people had complaints regarding it's short runtime. I have also made this change because I want a wider fanbase to try this game out and give the best feedback possible.


When?
This price change is expected to take place as soon as Valve approves it.


What about people who bought it earlier?
For the people who have bought it earlier, they can contact the developer showing proof that they bought the game, and a steam key would be given to them to get the developer's next project for free.


Further Queries
In case of further queries, you can ask the developer by joining the Discord Server. 


I hope this will eliminate some of the complaints. The rest will be dealt with updates that will come soon.
